final: WITH matched AS (SELECT a.translink, t.ordertypedist FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.peercorr >= 0.149 AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL), combos AS (SELECT translink, ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM matched GROUP BY translink, ordertypedist) SELECT translink, ordertypedist, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS frac FROM combos ORDER BY frac DESC, translink, ordertypedist LIMIT 10
